name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/obsidian-annotator
description: A hard fork of Obsidian Annotator (elias-sundqvist/obsidian-annotator): annotate PDFs in Obsidian with Hypothesis's own client, keeping the annotations in a note.
//scripts: Nx runs these (project.json). build.mjs bundles the plugin (src/) and its pages (frames/) with esbuild into dist/, with the Hypothesis client and PDF.js files the pages load; install-in-vault.mjs copies dist/ into a vault's plugin folder.
